prompt:
Top-down editorial still photograph, bright and airy. A single sheet of matte white paper lies flat on a seamless pure white paper backdrop, slightly rotated. Sunlight passes through an unseen glass prism from the lower right and casts a vivid, crisp rainbow spectrum band and a few soft prismatic flares diagonally across the backdrop and one corner of the sheet, leaving the printed text clear and readable.
The sheet is an agent team dashboard, a roster of AI agents coordinated by a Chief of Staff agent, built in AI & Agents Professional. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is, printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Chief of Staff"; "Research Analyst · ran 4 tasks"; "Operations Assistant · 1 waiting". The "1 waiting" status is set in bold.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. The prism itself is out of frame. Clean, bright, high-end.
